n = int(input())
q = list(map(int, input().split()))
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
b = list(map(int, input().split()))
max_servings = 0

for x in range(max(q) // min(a) + 1):
    y = float('inf')
    for i in range(n):
        if q[i] < x * a[i]:
            y = -float('inf')
            break
        if b[i] > 0:
            y = min(y, (q[i] - x * a[i]) // b[i])
    max_servings = max(max_servings, x + y)

print(max_servings)
